data.text: I am Rev. Fr. Mahan Aloysius from St. Anne’s parish Ilavalai.I had my primary education at Roman Catholic Tamil Boys’ School, Ilavalai,and my secondary education at St. Henry’s College, Ilavalai.I joined St. Martin’s Seminary in 1988 and continued my secondary education from Gr. 10 at St. Patrick’s.Life at St. Patrick’s was so wonderful and unforgettable.I was ordained as a priest in 2002 and attached to St. Patrick’s again in 2006.I started my life as a teacher of English and soon became prefect of studies, warden and Vice-Rector.In 2009 I left for London for my Master’s and Ph.D. On my return to the diocese in 2015, I rejoined the College and became Vice-Rector again in 2018 to-date.Though challenging, teaching and forming the youngsters gives me great joy and happiness.
